description: This file defines data structures and functions for handling HTTP headers within the Lighttpd server project. It provides APIs for creating, manipulating, searching, and freeing HTTP header entries, as well as a tokenizer for parsing header strings.

classes.name: liHttpHeader
classes.description: Represents a single HTTP header with a key length and data string containing 'headername: value'.

classes.name: liHttpHeaders
classes.description: Represents a collection of HTTP headers stored in a queue structure.

classes.name: liHttpHeaderTokenizer
classes.description: A tokenizer for parsing HTTP header values, supporting split on spaces and commas, with escape handling and quote recognition.

methods.name: li_http_headers_new
methods.description: Creates and returns a new, empty collection of HTTP headers.

methods.name: li_http_headers_reset
methods.description: Resets the HTTP headers collection to an empty state.

methods.name: li_http_headers_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with the HTTP headers collection.

methods.name: li_http_header_append
methods.description: Appends a value to a header key, adding a comma-separated value if the header already exists.

methods.name: li_http_header_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new header key-value pair into the collection.

methods.name: li_http_header_overwrite
methods.description: Overwrites any existing header with the same key with a new value.

methods.name: li_http_header_remove
methods.description: Removes all headers with the specified key.

methods.name: li_http_header_remove_link
methods.description: Removes a specific header entry represented by a list link.

methods.name: li_http_header_lookup
methods.description: Finds the first header with the specified key.

methods.name: li_http_header_find_first
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a header with the specified key.

methods.name: li_http_header_find_next
methods.description: Finds the next header with the specified key after a given list node.

methods.name: li_http_header_find_last
methods.description: Finds the last header with the specified key.

methods.name: li_http_header_is
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specific key has a value matching case-insensitively.

methods.name: li_http_header_get_all
methods.description: Concatenates all headers with the specified key into a string separated by commas.

methods.name: li_http_header_tokenizer_start
methods.description: Initializes a tokenizer for parsing headers with a specific key.

methods.name: li_http_header_tokenizer_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the header tokenizer, handling quotes and escapes.

methods.name: INLINE gboolean li_http_header_key_is(liHttpHeader * h,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)

ctags.name: keylen
ctags.pattern: /^	guint keylen;     \/** length of "headername" in data *\/$/

ctags.name: li_http_header_key_is
ctags.pattern: /^INLINE gboolean li_http_header_key_is(liHttpHeader *h, const gchar *key, size_t keylen) {$/
